name: habit
description: 每日一记 —— 学习前的间隔重复小卡片

scripts.build: electron-packager . Habit --platform=darwin --arch=$(node -p process.arch) --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=local.habit.app --app-category-type=public.app-category.education --out=dist --overwrite --ignore='^/(dist|test|build|data|docs|android|www|scripts|capacitor\.config\.json)($|/)' && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/Habit-darwin-$(node -p process.arch)/Habit.app
scripts.install-app: npm run build && rm -rf /Applications/Habit.app && cp -R dist/Habit-darwin-$(node -p process.arch)/Habit.app /Applications/
scripts.zip: npm run build && ditto -c -k --keepParent dist/Habit-darwin-$(node -p process.arch)/Habit.app dist/Habit-mac-$(node -p process.arch).zip
scripts.android: node scripts/build-web.mjs && cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../dist && cp app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ../dist/Habit-android.apk
